question: Get details of repositories that use specific feature toggle libraries. For each repository, include the full name with owner, hosting platform type, size in bytes, primary programming language, fork source name (if any), last update timestamp, the artifact and library names of the feature toggle used, and the library's programming languages. SELECT DISTINCT
  ftl.artifact_name,
  ftl.library_name,
  ftl.languages AS library_languages,
  pwr.repository_name_with_owner,
  pwr.repository_host_type,
  pwr.repository_size * 1024 AS size_in_bytes,
  pwr.repository_language,
  pwr.repository_fork_source_name_with_owner,
  pwr.repository_updated_timestamp
FROM `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.dependencies` d
JOIN feature_toggle_libraries ftl
  ON d.dependency_name = ftl.artifact_name AND d.dependency_platform = ftl.platform
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.projects_with_repository_fields` pwr
  ON d.project_id = pwr.id AND d.platform = pwr.platform
ORDER BY pwr.repository_name_with_owner, ftl.artifact_name
